ward.summary: Govandi, Mankhurd, Deonar (ward M/E) used ₹72.4 lakh of its ₹91.0 lakh budget, 80%, and stayed within budget across 148 jobs. Repairs redone within 30 days were 26%, in line with the 24% expected, though ₹14.3 lakh went on repairs that failed. This is a flood-prone ward (flood index 0.75), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. Only 41% of jobs finished on time, worse than the expected 49%. Eight jobs are listed for review, and ₹13.8 lakh was paid on 32 jobs on roads under warranty. The ward should next fund 26 open issues costing ₹7.8 lakh, starting with Ghatkopar Mankhurd Link Road. The remaining ₹18.6 lakh covers all of them.
